items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Lee Hilliard -- I mentioned him -- Lee Hilliard. There was A. G. Godley who played the drums.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Yeah. He still plays it, yeah. That's one of his features, yeah. And he has a combo. He plays in all the smart clubs and things in, I believe, New York, New Jersey, around. He's well known in musical circles. Snub Mosley.

Of course, James Jeeter was -- James Jeeter, my partner, was the first alto player. He never did play any hot saxophone, but he played first saxophone. Lee Hilliard -- I mentioned him -- Lee Hilliard. There was A. G. Godley who played the drums. A. G. Godley wrote a book on drums. He
never was able to get it published. But this man was every bit an artist.
